<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def pos(fr, color):
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']==color:
            r0=min(p[0] for p in n['boundary']); c0=min(p[1] for p in n['boundary'])
            return (r0,c0)
    return None
def cell(px):
    # grid origin: col 12, row 21, cell size 3
    if px is None: return None
    return ((px[0]-21)//3, (px[1]-12)//3)
print('start: player', cell(pos(current_frame,'b')), 'enemy', cell(pos(current_frame,'R')))
seq=['UP','DOWN','UP','DOWN']
for a in seq:
    r=action([a])
    if r.get('game_over') or r.get('run_complete'):
        print('STOP after', a, r)
        break
    print(a, '-> player', cell(pos(current_frame,'b')), 'enemy', cell(pos(current_frame,'R')), 'go', r.get('game_over'))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
